title.zh: 卷九十九 志第五十二 禮二
title.raw: 卷九十九 志第五十二 禮二 Volume 99 Treatises 52: Rites 2

sentences.zh: 南郊壇制。

translations.literal: Regulations for the Southern Suburban Altar.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations governing the Southern Suburban Altar.

sentences.zh: 梁及後唐郊壇皆在洛陽。

translations.literal: The suburban altars of Liang and Later Tang were all at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Under both Liang and Later Tang, the suburban sacrifice altars were located at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 宋初始作壇于東都南薰門外，四成、十二陛、三壝。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song an altar was first built outside the Nanxun Gate of the Eastern Capital, with four tiers, twelve stairways, and three enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song dynasty was first established, an altar was erected outside the Nanxun Gate of the Eastern Capital, built in four tiers with twelve stairways and three surrounding enclosures.

sentences.zh: 設燎壇於內壇之外丙地，高一丈二尺。

translations.literal: A fire altar was set up in the bing position outside the inner enclosure, twelve chi in height.
translations.idiomatic: A fire altar for burning offerings was placed in the bing sector outside the inner enclosure, twelve feet high.

sentences.zh: 設皇帝更衣大次於東壝東門之內道北，南向。

translations.literal: The emperor's grand changing pavilion was set on the north side of the inner path inside the east gate of the eastern enclosure, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's grand robing pavilion was established north of the inner passage inside the eastern gate of the east enclosure, facing south.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天聖六年，始築外壝，周以短垣，置靈星門。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiansheng under Emperor Renzong, the outer enclosure was first built, encircled with a low wall, and a Spirit Star Gate was installed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Tiansheng era (1028), Emperor Renzong had the outer enclosure built for the first time, ringed with a low wall and furnished with a Spirit Star Gate.

sentences.zh: 親郊則立表於青城，表三壝。

translations.literal: When the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice, markers were erected at the Azure City, marking the three enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor conducted the suburban rite in person, ritual markers were set up at the Azure City to delineate the three enclosures.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙寧七年，詔中書、門下參定青城殿宇門名。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining under Emperor Shenzong, an edict ordered the Secretariat and Chancellery to deliberate and fix the names of the halls and gates of the Azure City.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of the Xining era (1074), Emperor Shenzong ordered the Secretariat and Chancellery to determine the official names for the halls and gates of the Azure City.

sentences.zh: 先是，每郊撰進，至是始定名，前門曰泰禋，東偏門曰迎禧，正東門曰祥曦，正西門曰景曜，後三門曰拱極，內東側門曰夤明，西側門曰肅成，殿曰端誠，殿前東、西門曰左右嘉德，便殿曰熙成，後園門曰寶華，著為定式。

translations.literal: Previously, at each suburban sacrifice names were drafted and submitted; only now were names first fixed: the front gate was called Great Offering, the east side gate Welcoming Blessings, the main east gate Auspicious Dawn, the main west gate Radiant Splendor, the three rear gates Arching the Pole, the inner east side gate Dawn Brightness, the west side gate Solemn Completion, the hall Sincere Integrity, the east and west gates before the hall Left and Right Virtue, the side hall Flourishing Completion, the rear garden gate Treasured Splendor — established as the fixed pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Until then, new names had been proposed afresh before each suburban sacrifice; only now were they fixed for good. The front gate was named Great Offering; the east side gate, Welcoming Blessings; the main east gate, Auspicious Dawn; the main west gate, Radiant Splendor; the three rear gates, Arching the Pole; the inner east side gate, Dawn Brightness; the west side gate, Solemn Completion; the main hall, Sincere Integrity; the east and west gates before it, Left and Right Virtue; the side hall, Flourishing Completion; and the rear garden gate, Treasured Splendor. These were codified as the permanent standard.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年二月，詔內壝之外，眾星位周環，每二步植一杙，繚以青繩，以為限域。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yuanfeng, an edict ordered that outside the inner enclosure, where the positions of the host of stars ringed about, a stake should be planted every two paces and bound round with blue cord to serve as the demarcated area.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Yuanfeng (1078), an edict directed that beyond the inner enclosure, where the star deities were arrayed in a ring, a stake be planted every two paces and laced with blue cord to mark the boundary.

sentences.zh: 既而詳定奉祀禮文所言：「《周官》外祀皆有兆域，後世因之，稍增其制。

translations.literal: Subsequently, in what was said in the Deliberated Rites for Suburban and Temple Sacrifices: 'In the Offices of Zhou, outer sacrifices all had demarcated precincts; later ages followed this and gradually enlarged the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Later, the Deliberated Rites for Suburban and Temple Sacrifices stated: "According to the Offices of Zhou, all outer sacrifices had demarcated precincts; later dynasties followed this practice and gradually expanded the regulations.

sentences.zh: 國朝郊壇率循唐舊，雖儀注具載圜丘三壝，每壝二十五步，而有司乃以青繩代內壝，誠不足以等神位、序祀事、嚴內外之限也。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's suburban altars generally followed Tang precedent; although the ritual manuals fully record three enclosures for the Round Mound, each enclosure twenty-five paces, the responsible officials nevertheless used blue cord in place of the inner enclosure — truly insufficient to rank the spirit positions, order the sacrificial proceedings, and enforce the distinction between inner and outer.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban altars of our dynasty largely followed Tang practice. Although the ritual manuals clearly prescribe three enclosures for the Round Mound, each twenty-five paces wide, the responsible officials had substituted blue cord for the inner enclosure — which is plainly inadequate to distinguish ranks among the deities, sequence the rites, and enforce the separation of inner and outer precincts.

sentences.zh: 伏請除去青繩，為三壝之制。

translations.literal: We respectfully request that the blue cord be removed and the three-enclosure system be instituted.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully ask that the blue cord be abolished and the proper three-enclosure arrangement restored.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 徽宗政和三年，詔有司討論壇壝之制。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe under Emperor Huizong, an edict ordered the responsible offices to discuss the regulations for the altar and its enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Zhenghe era (1113), Emperor Huizong ordered the relevant offices to deliberate on the design of the altar platform and its enclosures.

sentences.zh: 十月，禮制局言：「壇舊制四成，一成二十丈，再成十五丈，三成十丈，四成五丈，成高八尺一寸；

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Ritual Regulations Bureau reported: 'The old altar regulations had four tiers: the first tier twenty zhang, the second fifteen zhang, the third ten zhang, the fourth five zhang, each tier eight chi and one cun in height;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Ritual Regulations Bureau submitted: "Under the old regulations the altar had four tiers: the first tier measured twenty zhang across, the second fifteen, the third ten, and the fourth five, with each tier eight feet and one inch high;

sentences.zh: 十有二陛，陛十有二級；

translations.literal: there were twelve stairways, each stairway with twelve steps;
translations.idiomatic: there were twelve stairways, each with twelve steps;

sentences.zh: 三壝，二十五步。

translations.literal: and three enclosures of twenty-five paces each.
translations.idiomatic: and three enclosures, each twenty-five paces wide.

sentences.zh: 古所謂地上圜丘、澤中方丘，皆因地形之自然。

translations.literal: What antiquity called the round mound on high ground and the square mound in a marsh all followed the natural lay of the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient Round Mound on elevated ground and Square Mound in a marshland both conformed to natural topography.

sentences.zh: 王者建國，或無自然之丘，則于郊澤吉土以兆壇位。

translations.literal: When a king established his state, if there was no natural mound, he chose auspicious ground in the suburban marsh to mark out the altar site.
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler founded his state and no natural mound was available, he selected auspicious ground in the suburban marsh to establish the altar.

sentences.zh: 為壇之制，當用陽數，今定為壇三成，一成用九九之數，廣八十一丈，再成用六九之數，廣五十四丈，三成用三九之數，廣二十七丈。

translations.literal: The regulations for building an altar should employ yang numbers; it is now fixed that the altar shall have three tiers: the first tier using the number nine-times-nine, eighty-one zhang wide; the second using six-times-nine, fifty-four zhang wide; the third using three-times-nine, twenty-seven zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: Altar construction should follow yang numerology. It is now decreed that the altar shall have three tiers: the first, based on nine times nine, shall be eighty-one zhang wide; the second, on six times nine, fifty-four zhang; and the third, on three times nine, twenty-seven zhang.

sentences.zh: 每成高二十七尺，三成總二百七十有六，《乾》之策也。

translations.literal: Each tier is twenty-seven chi high; the three tiers total two hundred seventy-six — the tally of the hexagram Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Each tier shall stand twenty-seven feet high, the three tiers together totaling two hundred seventy-six feet — the number derived from the Qian hexagram.

sentences.zh: 為三壝，壝三十六步，亦《乾》之策也。

translations.literal: There shall be three enclosures, each thirty-six paces — also the tally of Qian.
translations.idiomatic: There shall be three enclosures, each thirty-six paces wide — likewise derived from the Qian hexagram.

sentences.zh: 成與壝地之數也。

translations.literal: These are the numbers for the tiers and the enclosures on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Such are the numerological proportions governing the tiers and enclosures.

sentences.zh: 」詔行之。

translations.literal: ' An edict ordered that this be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered these regulations put into effect.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，高宗至揚州，庶事草創，築壇于州南門內江都縣之東南，詔東京所屬官吏奉祭器、大樂、儀仗、法物赴行在所。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan, when Emperor Gaozong reached Yangzhou and all affairs were still being improvised, an altar was built southeast of Jiangdu County inside the south gate of the prefecture; an edict ordered officials subordinate to the Eastern Capital to convey sacrificial vessels, great music, insignia, and ritual objects to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianyan (1128), after Emperor Gaozong reached Yangzhou with government still in its infancy, an altar was erected southeast of Jiangdu County within the prefecture's south gate. An edict directed officials from the former Eastern Capital to bring sacrificial vessels, court music, insignia, and ritual implements to the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 紹興十三年，太常寺言：「國朝圓壇在國之東南，壇側建青城齋宮，以備郊宿。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: 'Our dynasty's Round Altar lies in the southeast of the realm; beside the altar the Azure City fasting palace was built to provide lodging for the suburban vigil.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Shaoxing (1143), the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "The dynasty's Round Altar stands in the southeast of the realm, with an Azure City fasting palace built beside it to house the emperor during the pre-sacrifice vigil.

sentences.zh: 今宜於臨安府行宮東南修建。

translations.literal: It is now fitting to build it southeast of the traveling palace in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It is now appropriate to construct the same southeast of the imperial residence in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 」於是，遂詔臨安府及殿前司修建圓壇，第一成縱廣七丈，第二成縱廣一十二丈，第三成縱廣一十七丈，第四成縱廣二十二丈。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon an edict ordered Lin'an Prefecture and the Palace Command to build the Round Altar: the first tier seven zhang long and wide, the second twelve zhang, the third seventeen zhang, the fourth twenty-two zhang.
translations.idiomatic: " Accordingly, Lin'an Prefecture and the Palace Command were ordered to build the Round Altar: the first tier seven zhang square, the second twelve, the third seventeen, and the fourth twenty-two.

sentences.zh: 一十二陛，每陛七十二級，每成一十二綴。

translations.literal: There were twelve stairways, each stairway with seventy-two steps, each tier with twelve courses.
translations.idiomatic: It had twelve stairways of seventy-two steps each, with twelve courses per tier.

sentences.zh: 三壝，第一壝去壇二十五步，中壝去內壝、外壝去中壝各半之。

translations.literal: Three enclosures: the first enclosure twenty-five paces from the altar; the middle enclosure from the inner, and the outer from the middle, each half that distance.
translations.idiomatic: Three enclosures were laid out: the innermost twenty-five paces from the altar, with the middle and outer enclosures each half again as far from the one inside it.

sentences.zh: 燎壇方一丈，高一丈二尺，開上南出戶，方六尺，三出陛，在壇南二十步丙地。

translations.literal: The fire altar was one zhang square and one zhang two chi high, open at the top with a door opening to the south six chi square, with three outward stairways, placed in the bing position twenty paces south of the altar.
translations.idiomatic: The fire altar was one zhang square and twelve feet high, open at the top with a six-foot square door facing south and three outward stairways, situated in the bing sector twenty paces south of the main altar.

sentences.zh: 其青城及望祭殿與行事陪祠官宿齋幕次，並令絞縛，更不修蓋。

translations.literal: As for the Azure City, the Hall for Gazing Sacrifice, and the fasting tent quarters for officiating and attendant sacrifice officials, all were ordered to be rigged with rope lashings only, with no permanent roofing.
translations.idiomatic: The Azure City, the Hall for Gazing Sacrifice, and the fasting tent quarters for officiating and attendant officials were all to be rope-rigged temporary structures, without permanent roofing.

sentences.zh: 先是，張杓為京尹，議築齋宮，可一勞永逸，宇文價曰：「陛下方經略河南，今築青城，是無中原也。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhang Biao was metropolitan magistrate, he proposed building a fasting palace that would settle the matter once for all; Yuwen Jia said: 'Your Majesty is just now planning recovery of the Henan region — to build the Azure City now is to give up on the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhang Biao served as metropolitan magistrate, he had proposed building a permanent fasting palace as a lasting solution. Yuwen Jia objected: "Your Majesty is still striving to recover Henan; to build the Azure City now would be to abandon hope of restoring the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 」遂罷役。

translations.literal: ' The work was then halted.
translations.idiomatic: " Construction was accordingly suspended.

sentences.zh: 神位。

translations.literal: Spirit Positions.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit Positions.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年十一月，詳定郊廟奉祀禮文所言：「按東漢壇位，天神從祀者至千五百一十四，故外設重營，以為等限。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Yuanfeng, in what was said in the Deliberated Rites for Suburban and Temple Sacrifices: 'According to the altar positions of Eastern Han, celestial deities attending sacrifice numbered as many as 1,514; therefore outer double encampments were set up to serve as graded limits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the first year of Yuanfeng (1078), the Deliberated Rites for Suburban and Temple Sacrifices explained: "Under Eastern Han altar arrangements, as many as 1,514 celestial deities received attendant sacrifice, so double outer encampments were established to demarcate ranks.

sentences.zh: 日月在中營內南道，而北斗在北道之西，至於五星中宮宿之屬，則其位皆中營，二十八宿外宮星之屬，則其位皆外營。

translations.literal: The sun and moon were on the south path within the inner encampment, while the Northern Dipper was west of the north path; as for the Five Stars and inner-palace asterisms, their positions were all in the inner encampment, while the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions and outer-palace stars had their positions all in the outer encampment.
translations.idiomatic: The sun and moon stood on the southern avenue within the inner encampment, and the Northern Dipper west of the northern avenue. The Five Stars and inner-palace constellations were all placed in the inner encampment, while the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions and outer-palace stars occupied the outer encampment.

sentences.zh: 然則為重營者，所以等神位也。

translations.literal: Thus the purpose of the double encampments was to rank the spirit positions.
translations.idiomatic: The double encampments, then, served to distinguish ranks among the deities.

sentences.zh: 唐因隋制，設為三壝，天神列位不出內壝，而御位特設於壇下之東南。

translations.literal: Tang followed Sui regulations and established three enclosures; the ranked positions of celestial deities did not extend beyond the inner enclosure, while the imperial position was specially set southeast below the altar.
translations.idiomatic: Tang adopted Sui practice and instituted three enclosures: celestial deities were ranked no farther out than the inner enclosure, while the emperor's position was specially placed southeast below the altar platform.

sentences.zh: 若夫公卿分獻、文武從祀，與夫樂架饌幔，則皆在中壝之內，而大次之設乃在外壝。

translations.literal: As for the separate offerings of dukes and ministers, the attendant sacrifices of civil and military officials, and the music stands and food curtains, all were within the middle enclosure, while the grand pavilions were set in the outer enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The separate offerings presented by dukes and ministers, the attendant sacrifices of civil and military officials, and the music stands and offering curtains all lay within the middle enclosure, whereas the grand pavilions were placed in the outer enclosure.

sentences.zh: 然則為三壝者，所以序祀事也。」

translations.literal: Thus the purpose of the three enclosures was to order the sacrificial proceedings.'
translations.idiomatic: The three enclosures, then, served to sequence the ritual proceedings."

sentences.zh: 景德三年，鹵簿使王欽若言：「漢以五帝為天神之佐，今在第一龕；

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingde, Imperial Escort Commissioner Wang Qinruo said: 'Han took the Five Emperors as assistants to the Celestial Thearch; they are now in the first niche;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingde (1006), Imperial Escort Commissioner Wang Qinruo reported: "The Han dynasty regarded the Five Emperors as assistants to the Celestial Thearch, yet they now occupy the first niche;

sentences.zh: 天皇大帝在第二龕，與六甲、嶽瀆之類接席；

translations.literal: the Great Celestial Thearch is in the second niche, sharing mats with the Six Jia and mountains and rivers;
translations.idiomatic: the Great Celestial Thearch stands in the second niche alongside the Six Jia spirits and the mountain and river deities;

sentences.zh: 帝座，天市之尊，今與二十八宿、積薪、騰蛇、杵臼之類同在第三龕。

translations.literal: the Imperial Seat, lord of the Celestial Market, is now together with the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions, Piled Firewood, Soaring Serpent, Pestle and Mortar, and the like in the third niche.
translations.idiomatic: and the Imperial Seat — sovereign of the Celestial Market Enclosure — now shares the third niche with the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions, Piled Firewood, Soaring Serpent, Pestle and Mortar, and similar lesser asterisms.

sentences.zh: 卑主尊臣，甚未便也。

translations.literal: The lowly presiding over the exalted — this is very inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: To have the humble ranked above the exalted is most improper.

sentences.zh: 若以北極、帝坐本非天帝，蓋是天帝所居，則北極在第二，帝坐在第三，亦高下未等。

translations.literal: If the Northern Pole and Imperial Seat are originally not the Celestial Thearch but rather the dwelling of the Celestial Thearch, then with the Northern Pole in the second rank and the Imperial Seat in the third, the high and low are still unequal.
translations.idiomatic: If the Northern Pole and Imperial Seat are not the Celestial Thearch himself but merely his dwelling, then placing the Northern Pole in the second rank and the Imperial Seat in the third still leaves their relative precedence unequal.

sentences.zh: 又太微之次少左右執法，子星之次少孫星，望令司天監參驗。

translations.literal: Moreover, in the Taiwei sequence the Left and Right Law-Enforcers are missing, and in the Son Star sequence the Grandson Star is missing; it is hoped that the Directorate of Astronomy may investigate and verify.
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, the Taiwei sequence lacks the Left and Right Law-Enforcers, and the Son Star sequence lacks the Grandson Star. We ask that the Directorate of Astronomy investigate and verify these matters.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔禮儀使、太常禮院、司天監檢定之。

translations.literal: ' An edict then ordered the Commissioner of Ritual, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office, and the Directorate of Astronomy to examine and fix the matter.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict thereupon directed the Commissioner of Ritual, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office, and the Directorate of Astronomy to review and determine the correct arrangement.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使趙安仁言：「按《開寶通禮》，元氣廣大則稱昊天，據遠視之蒼然，則稱蒼天。

translations.literal: Commissioner of Ritual Zhao Anren said: 'According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao, when primordial qi is vast it is called Vast Heaven; when viewed from afar in its azure expanse, it is called Azure Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner of Ritual Zhao Anren argued: "According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao, when primordial qi is vast it is called Vast Heaven; when viewed from afar in its azure expanse, it is called Azure Heaven.

sentences.zh: 人之所尊，莫過於帝，托之於天，故稱上帝。

translations.literal: What humans revere most is none other than the Thearch; entrusting this to Heaven, it is therefore called the Supreme Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: What humans revere above all is the sovereign; entrusting this reverence to Heaven, he is therefore called the Supreme Thearch.

sentences.zh: 天皇大帝即北辰耀魄寶也，自是星中之尊。

translations.literal: The Great Celestial Thearch is the North Star Radiant Soul Treasure — by nature the most exalted among stars.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Celestial Thearch is the North Star known as Radiant Soul Treasure — by nature the most exalted among the stars.

sentences.zh: 《易》曰：'日月麗乎天，百穀草木麗乎土。

translations.literal: The Changes says: "The sun and moon are attached to heaven; the hundred grains and plants are attached to earth."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes states: "The sun and moon cling to heaven; the hundred grains and plants cling to earth."

sentences.zh: '又曰：'在天成象，在地成形。

translations.literal: ' It also says: "In heaven they form images; on earth they form shapes."
translations.idiomatic: It further states: "In heaven they form images; on earth they take shape."

sentences.zh: '蓋明辰象非天，草木非地，是則天以蒼昊為體，不入星辰之列。

translations.literal: ' This makes clear that stellar images are not heaven and plants are not earth; thus heaven takes azure vastness as its substance and does not enter the ranks of stars.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that stellar images are not heaven itself and plants are not earth itself; heaven takes azure vastness as its substance and does not belong among the stars.

sentences.zh: 又《郊祀錄》：'壇第二等祀天皇大帝、北斗、天一、太一、紫微、五帝坐，差在行位前，餘內官諸位及五星、十二辰、河漢，都四十九坐齊列，俱在十二陛之間。

translations.literal: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice also states: "The second rank of the altar sacrifices to the Great Celestial Thearch, Northern Dipper, Celestial One, Supreme One, Purple Forbidden, and Five Thearch Seats, slightly before the procession positions; the remaining inner-palace positions together with the Five Stars, Twelve Chronograms, and River Han — forty-nine seats in all aligned — all lie between the twelve stairways."
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice further records: "The altar's second rank receives sacrifice to the Great Celestial Thearch, the Northern Dipper, Celestial One, Supreme One, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and the Five Thearch Seats, placed slightly ahead of the procession line. The remaining inner-palace positions together with the Five Stars, Twelve Chronograms, and Milky Way — forty-nine seats in all — are aligned between the twelve stairways."

sentences.zh: ' 唐建中間，司天冬官正郭獻之奏：'天皇、北極、天一、太一，准《天寶敕》併合升第一等。

translations.literal: ' During the Jianzhong period of Tang, Winter Office Director Guo Xianzhi of the Directorate of Astronomy memorialized: "The Great Celestial Thearch, Northern Pole, Celestial One, and Supreme One, in accordance with the Tianbao edict, should together be promoted to the first rank."
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianzhong era of Tang, Guo Xianzhi, director of the Winter Office in the Directorate of Astronomy, memorialized that the Great Celestial Thearch, Northern Pole, Celestial One, and Supreme One should, per the Tianbao edict, all be promoted to the first rank.

sentences.zh: '貞元二年親郊，乙太常議，詔復從《開元禮》，仍為定制。

translations.literal: ' In the second year of Zhenyuan, when the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices deliberated on the yi day, and an edict restored compliance with the Kaiyuan Rites, which remained the fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor conducted the suburban rite in person in the second year of Zhenyuan (786), the Court of Imperial Sacrifices deliberated, and an edict restored the Kaiyuan Rites as the permanent standard.

sentences.zh: 《郊祀錄》又云：'壇第三等有中宮、天市垣、帝坐等十七坐，並在前。

translations.literal: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice also says: "The third rank of the altar has the Central Palace, Celestial Market Enclosure, Imperial Seat, and seventeen seats in all, all placed forward."
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice also states: "The altar's third rank includes the Central Palace, Celestial Market Enclosure, Imperial Seat, and seventeen positions in all, each placed in the forward row."

sentences.zh: '《開元禮義羅》云：'帝有五坐，一在紫微宮，一在大角，一在太微宮，一在心，一在天市垣。

translations.literal: ' The Exegesis of Kaiyuan Rites states: "The Thearch has five seats: one in the Purple Forbidden Palace, one at Great Horn, one in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, one at Heart, and one in the Celestial Market Enclosure."
translations.idiomatic: The Exegesis of Kaiyuan Rites explains: "The Thearch has five seats: one in the Purple Forbidden Palace, one at Great Horn, one in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, one at Heart, and one in the Celestial Market Enclosure."

sentences.zh: '即帝坐者非直指天帝也。

translations.literal: ' Thus the Imperial Seat does not directly refer to the Celestial Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Seat, then, does not refer directly to the Celestial Thearch himself.

sentences.zh: 又得判司天監史序狀：'天皇大帝一星在紫微勾陳中，其神曰耀魄寶，即天皇是星，五帝乃天帝也。

translations.literal: There was also the memorial of Acting Director of Astronomy Shi Xu: "The single star of the Great Celestial Thearch lies within the Purple Forbidden Hooked Array; its spirit is called Radiant Soul Treasure — the Great Celestial Thearch is a star; the Five Emperors are the Celestial Thearch."
translations.idiomatic: Acting Director of Astronomy Shi Xu also submitted a memorial stating: "The Great Celestial Thearch is a single star within the Purple Forbidden Hooked Array; its spirit is called Radiant Soul Treasure. The Great Celestial Thearch is a star; the Five Emperors are the Celestial Thearch."

sentences.zh: 北極五星在紫微垣內，居中一星曰北辰，第一主月為太子，第二主日為帝王，第三為庶子，第四為嫡子，第五為天子之樞，蓋北辰所主非一，又非帝坐之比。

translations.literal: The five stars of the Northern Pole lie within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; the central star is called North Star: the first governs the moon as heir apparent, the second governs the sun as the Thearch, the third is for the common son, the fourth for the legitimate son, the fifth for the pivot of the Son of Heaven — for the North Star governs more than one thing and is not comparable to the Imperial Seat.
translations.idiomatic: The five stars of the Northern Pole lie within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure. The central star is called the North Star: the first governs the moon and signifies the heir apparent; the second governs the sun and signifies the emperor; the third signifies the common son; the fourth the legitimate son; and the fifth the pivot of the Son of Heaven. The North Star governs many things and is not comparable to the Imperial Seat.

sentences.zh: 太微垣十星有左右執法、上將、次將之名，不可備陳，故總名太微垣。

translations.literal: The ten stars of the Supreme Palace Enclosure bear the names Left and Right Law-Enforcer, Senior General, and Junior General — they cannot all be enumerated, and so are collectively named the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The ten stars of the Supreme Palace Enclosure include the Left and Right Law-Enforcers, Senior General, and Junior General — too numerous to list individually — and are therefore collectively designated the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 《星經》舊載孫星，而《壇圖》止有子星，辨其尊卑，不可同位。

translations.literal: The Classic of Stars formerly recorded the Grandson Star, while the Altar Diagram has only the Son Star; distinguishing their relative honor, they cannot share the same position.
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of Stars records the Grandson Star, but the Altar Diagram includes only the Son Star. Given their difference in rank, they cannot occupy the same position.

sentences.zh: '竊惟《壇圖》舊制，悉有明據，天神定位，難以躋升，望依《星經》，悉以舊禮為定。」

translations.literal: ' I respectfully consider that the old regulations of the Altar Diagram all have clear warrant; the positioning of celestial deities is difficult to promote upward. It is hoped that in accordance with the Classic of Stars, the old rites may all be taken as fixed.'
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully observe that the established Altar Diagram rests on clear precedent, and the ranks of celestial deities should not be casually elevated. I ask that the Classic of Stars be followed and the existing ritual arrangement be maintained as the standard."

sentences.zh: 欽若復言：「舊史《天文志》並云：北極，北辰最尊者。

translations.literal: Qinruo again said: 'The Astronomical Treatises of the old histories all state: the Northern Pole — the North Star is the most exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo rejoined: "The Astronomical Treatises of earlier histories all declare that the Northern Pole — the North Star — is the most exalted.

sentences.zh: 又勾陳口中一星曰天皇大帝，鄭玄注《周禮》謂：'禮天者，冬至祭天皇於北極也。

translations.literal: Moreover, one star within the mouth of the Hooked Array is called the Great Celestial Thearch; Zheng Xuan's commentary on the Rites of Zhou states: "Those who perform rites to Heaven sacrifice to the Celestial Thearch at the Northern Pole at the winter solstice."
translations.idiomatic: One star within the mouth of the Hooked Array is called the Great Celestial Thearch. Zheng Xuan's commentary on the Rites of Zhou states: "Those who worship Heaven sacrifice to the Celestial Thearch at the Northern Pole at the winter solstice."

sentences.zh: '後魏孝文禋六宗，亦升天皇五帝上。

translations.literal: ' Emperor Xiaowen of Later Wei performed the yin sacrifice to the Six Ancestors and also elevated the Great Celestial Thearch above the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei performed the yin sacrifice to the Six Ancestors and likewise ranked the Great Celestial Thearch above the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 按晉《天文志》：'帝坐光而潤，則天子吉，威令行。

translations.literal: According to the Jin Astronomical Treatise: "When the Imperial Seat is bright and lustrous, the Son of Heaven is fortunate and his commands are enforced."
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Astronomical Treatise records: "When the Imperial Seat shines bright and lustrous, the Son of Heaven is fortunate and his commands prevail."

sentences.zh: '既名帝坐，則為天子所占，列於下位，未見其可。

translations.literal: ' Since it is called the Imperial Seat, it is what the Son of Heaven occupies; to place it in a lower rank — I do not see how this can be right.
translations.idiomatic: Since it is called the Imperial Seat, it signifies the Son of Heaven himself; to rank it in a lower position seems plainly wrong.

sentences.zh: 又安仁議，以子、孫二星不可同位。

translations.literal: Moreover, in Anren's proposal the Son and Grandson stars cannot share a position.
translations.idiomatic: Anren's proposal that the Son and Grandson stars cannot share a position is well taken.

sentences.zh: 陛下方洽高禖之慶，以廣維城之基，苟因前代闕文，便為得禮，實恐聖朝茂典，尤未適中。

translations.literal: Your Majesty is just now enjoying the blessings of the High Matron to broaden the foundation of the imperial domain; if we simply follow lacunae in the texts of former ages and call that obtaining the rites, I truly fear that the splendid regulations of our sage dynasty will fall especially short of what is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is presently celebrating the blessings of the High Matron to strengthen the imperial house. To treat gaps in earlier texts as sufficient grounds for ritual propriety would, I fear, leave our dynasty's splendid ceremonial code far short of what is fitting.

sentences.zh: 」詔天皇、北極特升第一龕，又設孫星于子星位次，帝坐如故。

translations.literal: ' An edict specially promoted the Great Celestial Thearch and Northern Pole to the first niche, also established the Grandson Star in the position following the Son Star, while the Imperial Seat remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict specially elevated the Great Celestial Thearch and Northern Pole to the first niche, established the Grandson Star in the position after the Son Star, and left the Imperial Seat unchanged.

sentences.zh: 欽若又言：「帝坐止三，紫微、太微者已列第二等，唯天市一坐在第三等。

translations.literal: Qinruo again said: 'There are only three Imperial Seats; those of Purple Forbidden and Supreme Palace are already in the second rank — only the Celestial Market seat is in the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo added: "There are only three true Imperial Seats. Those of the Purple Forbidden and Supreme Palace Enclosures already occupy the second rank; only the Celestial Market seat remains in the third.

sentences.zh: 按《晉志》，大角及心中星但雲天王坐，實與帝坐不類。

translations.literal: According to the Jin Treatise, Great Horn and the star at Heart are only called Heavenly King Seats — in fact they are not of the same kind as the Imperial Seat.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Jin Treatise, Great Horn and the star at Heart are merely called Heavenly King Seats and are not truly comparable to the Imperial Seat.

sentences.zh: 」詔特升第二龕。

translations.literal: ' An edict specially promoted it to the second niche.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict specially elevated it to the second niche.

sentences.zh: 舊郊丘，神位板皆有司題署，命欽若改造之。

translations.literal: At the old suburban mound altars, the spirit-position tablets were all inscribed by responsible officials; Qinruo was ordered to remake them.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban altars, spirit-position tablets had previously been inscribed by responsible officials; Qinruo was ordered to remake them.

sentences.zh: 至是，欽若奉板便殿，壇上四位，塗以朱漆金字，余皆黑漆，第一等金字，第二等黃字，第三等以降朱字，悉貯漆匣，覆以黃縑帊。

translations.literal: At this time Qinruo presented the tablets in the side hall: the four positions on the altar were coated with cinnabar lacquer and gold characters; the rest were black lacquer — first rank in gold characters, second rank in yellow characters, third rank and below in cinnabar characters — all stored in lacquer cases covered with yellow silk cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo then presented the tablets in the side hall. The four positions on the altar platform were finished in cinnabar lacquer with gold lettering; the rest in black lacquer — first rank in gold, second in yellow, third and below in cinnabar — each stored in a lacquered case covered with yellow silk.

sentences.zh: 帝降階觀之，即付有司。

translations.literal: The emperor descended the steps to view them and immediately handed them over to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended to inspect them and immediately entrusted them to the responsible officials.

sentences.zh: 又以新定《壇圖》，五帝、五嶽、中鎮、河漢合在第三等。

translations.literal: According to the newly fixed Altar Diagram, the Five Emperors, Five Sacred Mountains, Central Peak, and River Han were together placed in the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Under the newly fixed Altar Diagram, the Five Emperors, Five Sacred Mountains, Central Peak, and Milky Way were all grouped in the third rank.

sentences.zh: 四年，判太常禮院孫奭言：「准禮，冬至祀圜丘，有司攝事，以天神六百九十位從祀。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Sun Shi, acting head of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office, said: 'According to the rites, at the winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound, when officials perform the ceremony by proxy, six hundred ninety celestial deities attend in sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Sun Shi of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office reported: "According to ritual precedent, when officials conduct the winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound by proxy, six hundred ninety celestial deities receive attendant sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今惟有五方上帝及五人神十七位，天皇大帝以下並不設位。

translations.literal: Now there are only the Five Directional Supreme Thearchs and seventeen human-spirit deities; from the Great Celestial Thearch downward no positions are established.
translations.idiomatic: At present only the Five Directional Supreme Thearchs and seventeen human-spirit deities are honored; from the Great Celestial Thearch downward no positions are established at all.

sentences.zh: 且太昊、勾芒，惟孟夏雩祀、季秋大享及之，今乃祀於冬至，恐未協宜。

translations.literal: Moreover, Taihao and Goumang are reached only at the midsummer rain sacrifice and the autumn great offering; to sacrifice to them now at the winter solstice — I fear this may not be appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Taihao and Goumang are honored only at the midsummer rain sacrifice and the autumn great offering; to include them in the winter solstice rite may be inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 」翰林學士晁迥等言：「按《開寶通禮》：圜丘，有司攝事，祀昊天、配帝、五方帝、日月、五星、中官、外官、眾星總六百八十七位；

translations.literal: ' Hanlin Academician Chao Jiong and others said: 'According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao: at the Round Mound, when officials perform by proxy, they sacrifice to Vast Heaven, the associated Thearch, the Five Directional Thearchs, sun and moon, Five Stars, inner-palace, outer-palace, and host of stars — six hundred eighty-seven positions in all;
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Chao Jiong and others replied: "According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao, when officials conduct the Round Mound sacrifice by proxy, they honor Vast Heaven, the associated Thearch, the Five Directional Thearchs, the sun and moon, the Five Stars, inner-palace stars, outer-palace stars, and the host of stars — six hundred eighty-seven positions in all;

sentences.zh: 雩祀、大享，昊天、配帝、五天帝、五人帝、五官總十七位；

translations.literal: at the rain sacrifice and great offering, Vast Heaven, the associated Thearch, Five Heavenly Thearchs, Five Human Thearchs, and Five Officials — seventeen positions in all;
translations.idiomatic: at the rain sacrifice and great offering, Vast Heaven, the associated Thearch, the Five Heavenly Thearchs, Five Human Thearchs, and Five Officials — seventeen positions in all;

sentences.zh: 方丘，祭皇地祇、配帝、神州、嶽鎮、海瀆七十一位。

translations.literal: at the Square Mound, they sacrifice to Imperial Earth, the associated Thearch, the Divine Land, mountains, peaks, seas, and rivers — seventy-one positions.
translations.idiomatic: and at the Square Mound, Imperial Earth, the associated Thearch, the Divine Land, mountains, peaks, seas, and rivers — seventy-one positions.

sentences.zh: 今司天監所設圜丘、雩祀、明堂、方丘並七十位，即是方丘有嶽、瀆從祀，圜丘無星辰，而反以人帝從祀。

translations.literal: Now the arrangements of the Directorate of Astronomy for the Round Mound, rain sacrifice, Bright Hall, and Square Mound all have seventy positions — meaning the Square Mound has mountains and rivers in attendant sacrifice while the Round Mound has no stars, yet human thearchs are instead given attendant sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy now assigns only seventy positions each to the Round Mound, rain sacrifice, Bright Hall, and Square Mound — so that mountains and rivers attend at the Square Mound while the Round Mound has no stars, yet human thearchs are given attendant sacrifice instead.

sentences.zh: 望如奭請，以《通禮》及神位為定，其有增益者如後敕。

translations.literal: It is hoped that, as Sun Shi requested, the Comprehensive Rites and spirit positions may be taken as fixed; any additions may follow later edicts.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that Sun Shi's request be granted and the Comprehensive Rites and established spirit positions be taken as the standard, with any additions to follow subsequent edicts.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，議禮局上《五禮新儀》：皇帝祀昊天上帝，太史設神位版，昊天上帝位於壇上北方南向，席以稿秸；

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, the Deliberative Ritual Bureau submitted the New Rites of the Five Sacrifices: when the emperor sacrifices to the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven, the Grand Astrologer sets out the spirit-position tablets; the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven is positioned on the altar in the north facing south, with a mat of straw stalks;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenghe (1113), the Deliberative Ritual Bureau submitted the New Rites of the Five Sacrifices: when the emperor sacrifices to the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven, the Grand Astrologer sets out the spirit-position tablets. The Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven stands on the northern side of the altar facing south, upon a mat of straw stalks;

sentences.zh: 太祖位於壇上東方西向，席以蒲越；

translations.literal: the Founding Ancestor is on the east of the altar facing west, with a mat of woven rushes;
translations.idiomatic: the Founding Ancestor stands on the eastern side of the altar facing west, upon a woven rush mat;

sentences.zh: 天皇大帝、五帝、大明、夜明、北極九位於第一龕；

translations.literal: the Great Celestial Thearch, Five Emperors, Great Brightness, Night Brightness, and Northern Pole — nine positions in the first niche;
translations.idiomatic: the Great Celestial Thearch, Five Emperors, Great Brightness, Night Brightness, and Northern Pole — nine deities in the first niche;

sentences.zh: 北斗、太一、帝坐、五帝內坐、五星、十二辰、河漢等內官神位五十有四於第二龕；

translations.literal: Northern Dipper, Supreme One, Imperial Seat, Five Thearch Inner Seats, Five Stars, Twelve Chronograms, River Han, and other inner-palace spirit positions — fifty-four in the second niche;
translations.idiomatic: the Northern Dipper, Supreme One, Imperial Seat, Five Thearch Inner Seats, Five Stars, Twelve Chronograms, Milky Way, and other inner-palace deities — fifty-four in the second niche;

sentences.zh: 二十八宿等中官神位百五十有九於第三龕；

translations.literal: the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions and other central-palace spirit positions — one hundred fifty-nine in the third niche;
translations.idiomatic: the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions and other central-palace deities — one hundred fifty-nine in the third niche;

sentences.zh: 外官神位一百有六於內壝之內；

translations.literal: outer-palace spirit positions — one hundred six within the inner enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: outer-palace deities — one hundred six within the inner enclosure;

sentences.zh: 眾星三百有六十於內壝之外。

translations.literal: the host of stars — three hundred sixty outside the inner enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: and the host of stars — three hundred sixty outside the inner enclosure.

sentences.zh: 第一龕席以稿秸，余以莞席，皆內向配位。

translations.literal: The first niche uses straw-stalk mats; the rest use sedge mats; all associated positions face inward.
translations.idiomatic: The first niche uses straw-stalk mats; the others use sedge mats. All associated positions face inward.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，詔以四月幸西京，有事於南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict ordered that in the fourth month the emperor would visit the Western Capital to perform the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict announced that in the fourth month the emperor would visit the Western Capital to conduct the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 自國初以來，南郊四祭及感生帝、皇地祇、神州凡七祭，並以四祖迭配。

translations.literal: Since the beginning of the dynasty, the four suburban sacrifices and the sacrifices to the Life-Generating Thearch, Imperial Earth, and Divine Land — seven sacrifices in all — have all used the four ancestors in rotation as associates.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the dynasty, the four suburban sacrifices together with those to the Life-Generating Thearch, Imperial Earth, and the Divine Land — seven rites in all — have assigned the four imperial ancestors in rotation as associated spirits.

sentences.zh: 太祖親郊者四，並以宣祖配。

translations.literal: The Founding Ancestor personally performed the suburban sacrifice four times, each time with the Proclamation Ancestor as associate.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Ancestor conducted the suburban sacrifice in person four times, each time with the Proclamation Ancestor as the associated spirit.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，其七祭但以宣祖、太祖更配。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizong took the throne, for the seven sacrifices only the Proclamation Ancestor and Founding Ancestor were rotated as associates.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizong ascended the throne, the seven sacrifices alternated only between the Proclamation Ancestor and the Founding Ancestor as associates.

sentences.zh: 是歲親享天地，始奉太祖升侑。

translations.literal: That year, when he personally enjoyed sacrifice to Heaven and Earth, he first elevated the Founding Ancestor to attendant sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when he personally sacrificed to Heaven and Earth, he first elevated the Founding Ancestor to share the offering.

sentences.zh: 雍熙元年冬至親郊，從禮儀使扈蒙之議，復以宣祖配。

translations.literal: At the winter solstice suburban sacrifice in the first year of Yongxi, following the proposal of Commissioner of Ritual Hu Meng, the Proclamation Ancestor was again made associate.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice suburban sacrifice in the first year of Yongxi (984), following Commissioner of Ritual Hu Meng's proposal, the Proclamation Ancestor was again made the associated spirit.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，禮儀使蘇易簡言：「親祀圜丘，以宣祖配，此則符聖人大孝之道，成嚴父配天之儀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Commissioner of Ritual Su Yijian said: 'When personally sacrificing at the Round Mound with the Proclamation Ancestor as associate, this accords with the sage's supreme path of filial piety and completes the rite of the revered father matching Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Commissioner of Ritual Su Yijian argued: "To sacrifice personally at the Round Mound with the Proclamation Ancestor as associate accords with the sage's supreme path of filial piety and fulfills the rite of the revered father sharing Heaven's altar.

sentences.zh: 太祖皇帝光啟丕圖，恭臨大寶，以聖授聖，傳於無窮。

translations.literal: The Founding Ancestor emperor brilliantly opened the great enterprise, respectfully assumed the great mandate, sage transmitting to sage, passing it on without end.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Ancestor brilliantly inaugurated the great enterprise, reverently assumed the imperial throne, and passed the sage's mandate from sage to sage for all eternity.

sentences.zh: 按唐永徽中，以高祖、太宗同配上帝。

translations.literal: According to Tang in the Yonghui period, Gaozu and Taizong were jointly made associates of the Supreme Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang, during the Yonghui period, Gaozu and Taizong were jointly associated with the Supreme Thearch.

sentences.zh: 欲望將來親祀郊丘，奉宣祖、太祖同配；

translations.literal: It is desired that in future personal sacrifices at the suburban mounds, the Proclamation Ancestor and Founding Ancestor be jointly associated;
translations.idiomatic: We ask that in future personal suburban sacrifices, the Proclamation Ancestor and Founding Ancestor serve jointly as associates;

sentences.zh: 其常祀祈穀、神州、明堂，以宣祖崇配；

translations.literal: for the regular sacrifices of Prayer for Grain, Divine Land, and Bright Hall, the Proclamation Ancestor be honored as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the regular sacrifices of Prayer for Grain, Divine Land, and Bright Hall, the Proclamation Ancestor be honored as associate;

sentences.zh: 圜丘、北郊、雩祀，以太祖崇配。

translations.literal: for the Round Mound, Northern Suburb, and rain sacrifice, the Founding Ancestor be honored as associate.
translations.idiomatic: and for the Round Mound, Northern Suburb, and rain sacrifice, the Founding Ancestor be honored as associate.

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: ' The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 真宗至道三年十一月，有司言：「冬至圜丘、孟夏雩祀、夏至方丘，請奉太宗配；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Zhidao under Emperor Zhenzong, the responsible offices reported: 'For the winter solstice Round Mound, midsummer rain sacrifice, and summer solstice Square Mound, we request that Emperor Taizong be made associate;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year of Zhidao (997), the responsible offices reported: "For the winter solstice Round Mound, midsummer rain sacrifice, and summer solstice Square Mound, we request that Emperor Taizong serve as associate;

sentences.zh: 上辛祈谷、季秋明堂，奉太祖配；

translations.literal: for the first xin day Prayer for Grain and autumn Bright Hall, the Founding Ancestor be made associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the first xin day Prayer for Grain and the autumn Bright Hall sacrifice, the Founding Ancestor;

sentences.zh: 上辛祀感生帝、孟冬祭神州地祇，奉宣祖配；

translations.literal: for the first xin day sacrifice to the Life-Generating Thearch and winter sacrifice to the Divine Land of Earth, the Proclamation Ancestor be made associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the first xin day sacrifice to the Life-Generating Thearch and the winter sacrifice to the Divine Land of Earth, the Proclamation Ancestor;

sentences.zh: 其親郊，奉太祖、太宗並配。

translations.literal: for personal suburban sacrifice, the Founding Ancestor and Taizong be jointly associated.
translations.idiomatic: and for personal suburban sacrifice, the Founding Ancestor and Taizong jointly.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: ' An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict approved.

sentences.zh: 乾興元年，真宗崩，詔禮官定遷郊祀配帝，乃請：「祈穀及祭神州地祇，以太祖配；

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianxing, when Emperor Zhenzong died, an edict ordered ritual officials to fix the associated thearchs for suburban sacrifice after the imperial move; they requested: 'For Prayer for Grain and sacrifice to the Divine Land of Earth, the Founding Ancestor as associate;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianxing (1022), after Emperor Zhenzong's death, ritual officials were ordered to determine the associated spirits for suburban sacrifice. They proposed: "For Prayer for Grain and sacrifice to the Divine Land of Earth, the Founding Ancestor;

sentences.zh: 雩祀及昊天上帝及皇地祇，乙太宗配；

translations.literal: for the rain sacrifice and Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven and Imperial Earth, on the yi day Taizong as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the rain sacrifice, Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven, and Imperial Earth, Taizong on the yi day;

sentences.zh: 感生帝，以宣祖配；

translations.literal: for the Life-Generating Thearch, the Proclamation Ancestor as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the Life-Generating Thearch, the Proclamation Ancestor;

sentences.zh: 明堂，以真宗配；

translations.literal: for the Bright Hall, Zhenzong as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the Bright Hall, Emperor Zhenzong;

sentences.zh: 親祀郊丘，以太祖、太宗配。

translations.literal: for personal sacrifice at the suburban mounds, the Founding Ancestor and Taizong as associates.
translations.idiomatic: and for personal suburban sacrifice, the Founding Ancestor and Taizong."

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: ' The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年郊，詔以太祖、太宗、真宗三廟萬世不遷。

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice in the second year of Jingyou, an edict declared that the temples of the Founding Ancestor, Taizong, and Zhenzong would never be moved for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice in the second year of Jingyou (1035), an edict declared that the temples of the Founding Ancestor, Taizong, and Zhenzong would remain permanently fixed.

sentences.zh: 南郊以太祖定配，二宗迭配，親祀皆侑。

translations.literal: At the Southern Suburb the Founding Ancestor was the fixed associate; the two [later] ancestors rotated; at personal sacrifice all were attendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the Southern Suburb the Founding Ancestor was the fixed associate, with the two later emperors rotating; at personal sacrifice all shared the offering.

sentences.zh: 常祀圜丘、皇地祇配以太祖，祈谷、雩祀、神州配乙太宗，感生帝、明堂以宣祖、真宗配如舊。

translations.literal: For regular sacrifice at the Round Mound and Imperial Earth, the Founding Ancestor was associate; for Prayer for Grain, rain sacrifice, and Divine Land, on the yi day Taizong; for Life-Generating Thearch and Bright Hall, the Proclamation Ancestor and Zhenzong as before.
translations.idiomatic: At regular sacrifices to the Round Mound and Imperial Earth, the Founding Ancestor served as associate; for Prayer for Grain, rain sacrifice, and Divine Land, Taizong on the yi day; for the Life-Generating Thearch and Bright Hall, the Proclamation Ancestor and Zhenzong as before.

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年，判太常寺呂公綽言：「歷代郊祀，配位無側向，真宗示輔臣《封禪圖》曰：'嘗見郊祀昊天上帝，不以正坐，蓋皇地祇次之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingli, Lü Gongchuo, acting head of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, said: 'In suburban sacrifices of successive dynasties, associate positions had no sideways orientation. Emperor Zhenzong showed his ministers the Diagram of the Feng and Shan Sacrifices, saying: "I once saw that in suburban sacrifice to the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven he was not seated directly facing forward — for Imperial Earth comes next.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingli (1041), Lü Gongchuo of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "In past dynasties' suburban sacrifices, associate positions had no fixed sideways orientation. Emperor Zhenzong once showed his ministers the Diagram of the Feng and Shan Sacrifices, observing: "I once noticed that at suburban sacrifice to the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven, the deity was not seated directly forward — Imperial Earth comes next.

sentences.zh: 今修登封，上帝宜當子位，太祖、太宗配位，宜比郊祀而斜置之。

translations.literal: Now in performing the Mount Tai ascent and feng sacrifice, the Supreme Thearch should occupy the zi position; the associate positions of the Founding Ancestor and Taizong should, following suburban sacrifice, be placed obliquely."
translations.idiomatic: In performing the Mount Tai ascent, the Supreme Thearch should occupy the zi position, and the associate positions of the Founding Ancestor and Taizong should, as at suburban sacrifice, be placed obliquely."

sentences.zh: '其後，有司不諭先帝以告成報功、酌宜從變之意，每郊儀範，既引祥符側置之文，又載西向北上之禮，臨時擇一，未嘗考定。

translations.literal: ' Thereafter the responsible offices did not understand the late emperor's intent to report completion and repay merit and to adapt appropriately to change; in each suburban ritual manual they both cited the Xiangfu text on oblique placement and recorded the rite of facing west and proceeding north, choosing one at the moment — never examined and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the responsible offices failed to grasp the late emperor's intent to report completion, repay merit, and adapt ritual appropriately. Each suburban manual cited both the Xiangfu text on oblique placement and the rite of facing west and proceeding north, choosing between them ad hoc without ever settling the matter.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔南郊祖宗之配，並以東方西向為定。

translations.literal: ' An edict then fixed that associates of the ancestors at the Southern Suburb should all face west from the east.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then fixed that ancestral associates at the Southern Suburb should all stand on the east facing west.

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年郊，詔自今圜丘，三聖並侑。

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice in the fifth year of Huangyou, an edict ordered that from now on at the Round Mound all three sage emperors attend together.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice in the fifth year of Huangyou (1053), an edict ordered that henceforth at the Round Mound all three sage emperors share the offering together.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐六年，諫官楊畋論水災繇郊廟未順。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiayou, remonstrance official Yang Tian argued that the flood disaster arose from the suburban altars and ancestral temples being out of accord.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiayou (1061), remonstrance official Yang Tian argued that the floods arose because suburban altars and ancestral temples were not properly aligned.

sentences.zh: 禮院亦言：「對越天地，神無二主。

translations.literal: The Ritual Office also said: 'In facing Heaven and Earth, spirits have no dual sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Office also argued: "In worshipping Heaven and Earth, there can be no dual sovereign.

sentences.zh: 唐始用三祖同配，後遂罷之。

translations.literal: Tang at first used three ancestors jointly as associates, but later abolished this.
translations.idiomatic: Tang initially associated three ancestors jointly, but later abolished the practice.

sentences.zh: 皇祐初，詔三聖並侑，後復迭配，未幾復並侑，以為定制。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huangyou, an edict ordered all three sage emperors to attend together; later they rotated again; before long all three attended together again — taken as the fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Huangyou, an edict ordered all three sage emperors to share the offering; later they rotated again; soon all three shared again — and this became the fixed practice.

sentences.zh: 雖出孝思，然頗違經典，當時有司失於講求。

translations.literal: Although this sprang from filial devotion, it rather violated the classics; the responsible offices of the time failed in their investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Though born of filial devotion, it largely violated classical precedent, and the responsible offices of the time failed to investigate properly.

sentences.zh: 」下兩制議，翰林學士王珪等曰：「推尊以享帝，義之至也。

translations.literal: ' The matter was sent for deliberation to the two academies; Hanlin Academician Wang Gui and others said: 'To elevate and honor in sacrificing to the Thearch is the utmost of righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Hanlin and academies for deliberation. Wang Gui and others argued: "To elevate and honor in sacrificing to the Thearch is the highest expression of righteousness.

sentences.zh: 然尊尊不可以瀆，故郊無二主。

translations.literal: Yet the exalted may not be profaned; therefore at the suburban sacrifice there is no dual sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the exalted must not be profaned; therefore suburban sacrifice admits no dual sovereign.

sentences.zh: 今三後並侑，欲以致孝也，而適所以瀆乎享帝，非無以寧神也，請如禮官議。

translations.literal: Now with all three empresses attending together, intending to express filial piety, one thereby precisely profanes the sacrifice to the Thearch — this is not how to bring peace to the spirits. We request compliance with the ritual officials' proposal.
translations.idiomatic: To have all three emperors share the offering, though intended as filial piety, in fact profanes the sacrifice to the Thearch and fails to bring peace to the spirits. We ask that the ritual officials' proposal be adopted.

sentences.zh: 」七年正月，詔南郊以太祖定配。

translations.literal: ' In the first month of the seventh year, an edict fixed the Founding Ancestor as the permanent associate at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year (1062), an edict fixed the Founding Ancestor as the permanent associate at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎二年，車駕至揚州，築壇于江都縣之東南。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan under Emperor Gaozong, when the imperial carriage reached Yangzhou, an altar was built southeast of Jiangdu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianyan (1128), after the court reached Yangzhou, an altar was built southeast of Jiangdu County.

sentences.zh: 是歲冬至，祀昊天上帝，以太祖配。

translations.literal: That year at the winter solstice, the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven was sacrificed to, with the Founding Ancestor as associate.
translations.idiomatic: That winter solstice, the court sacrificed to the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven with the Founding Ancestor as associate.

sentences.zh: 度宗鹹淳二年，將舉郊祀，時復議以高宗參配。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianchun under Emperor Duzong, when a suburban sacrifice was to be held, there was renewed debate on having Gaozong share as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianchun (1266), as a suburban sacrifice was planned, debate resumed over including Emperor Gaozong as an associate.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎兼中書門下省檢正洪燾等議，以為：「物無二本，事無二初，舜之郊嚳，商之郊契，周郊後稷，皆所以推原其始也。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel and Secretariat Reviewer Hong Tao and others deliberated, holding: 'Things have no dual roots, affairs have no dual beginnings — Shun's suburban sacrifice to Ku, Shang's to Qi, Zhou's to Hou Ji all trace back to the origin.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Tao, Vice Minister of Personnel and Secretariat Reviewer, and others argued: "Things have no dual roots and affairs no dual beginnings. Shun's suburban sacrifice to Ku, Shang's to Qi, and Zhou's to Hou Ji all trace reverence to its origin.

sentences.zh: 禮者，所以別等差，視儀則，遠而尊者配於郊，近而親者配於明堂，明有等也。

translations.literal: Rites are what distinguish grades and observe ceremonial norms — the distant and exalted are associated at the suburb, the near and intimate at the Bright Hall; the grades are clear.
translations.idiomatic: Rites distinguish ranks and govern ceremonial propriety: the distant and exalted are associated at the suburb, the near and intimate at the Bright Hall — the hierarchy is explicit.

sentences.zh: 臣等謂宜如紹興故事，奉太宗配，將來明堂遵用先皇帝彝典，以高宗參侑，庶於報本之禮、奉先之孝，為兩盡其至。

translations.literal: We hold that it is fitting to follow the Shaoxing precedent, with Taizong as associate; when the Bright Hall is held in future, following the late emperor's constant regulation, Gaozong should share as attendant — thus in the rites of repaying the root and the filial piety of honoring ancestors, both may reach their utmost.
translations.idiomatic: We propose following the Shaoxing precedent with Taizong as associate at the suburb, and at the future Bright Hall following the late emperor's established regulation with Gaozong sharing the offering — thereby fulfilling both the rite of repaying one's origins and the filial piety of honoring ancestors to the fullest.

sentences.zh: 」詔恭依。

translations.literal: ' An edict respectfully approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The edict respectfully approved.

sentences.zh: 儀注。

translations.literal: Ritual Procedures.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual Procedures.

sentences.zh: 乾德元年八月，禮儀使陶穀言：「饗廟、郊天，兩日行禮，從祀官前七日皆合於尚書省受誓戒，自來一日之內受兩處誓戒，有虧虔潔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Qiande, Commissioner of Ritual Tao Gu said: 'Feasting the temple and sacrificing to Heaven are performed on two successive days; attendant sacrifice officials should all receive oath-abstention at the Secretariat seven days beforehand. From old times, receiving oath-abstention at two places in one day impairs reverent purity.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Qiande (963), Commissioner of Ritual Tao Gu reported: "The temple feast and Heaven sacrifice fall on consecutive days, and attendant officials should receive oath-abstention at the Secretariat seven days in advance. Receiving oath-abstention at two places in a single day impairs reverent purity.

sentences.zh: 今擬十一月十六日行郊禮，望依禮文於八日先受從享太廟誓戒，九日別受郊天誓戒，其日請放朝參。

translations.literal: It is now proposed to perform the suburban rite on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month; it is hoped that according to ritual texts, on the eighth day oath-abstention for attending the Grand Temple may first be received, on the ninth day suburban Heaven oath-abstention separately received, and on that day court attendance be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban rite is scheduled for the sixteenth of the eleventh month. We ask that on the eighth, officials first receive oath-abstention for attending the Grand Temple, and on the ninth receive separate oath-abstention for the Heaven sacrifice, with court attendance suspended on that day.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 自後百官受誓戒於朝堂，宗室受於太廟。

translations.literal: Thereafter all officials received oath-abstention in the court hall; the imperial clan received it at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter civil officials received oath-abstention in the court hall, and the imperial clan at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 祭之日均用丑時，秋夏以一刻，春冬以七刻，前二日遣官奏告。

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice the chou hour was uniformly used; in autumn and summer one quarter-watch before, in spring and winter seven quarter-watches before; two days prior officials were dispatched to report the announcement.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices were timed to the chou hour: one quarter-watch earlier in autumn and summer, seven quarter-watches earlier in spring and winter. Two days beforehand, officials were dispatched to announce the rite.

sentences.zh: 配帝之室，儀鸞司設大次、小次及文武侍臣、蕃客之次，太常設樂位、神位、版位等事。

translations.literal: In the chamber of the associated Thearch, the Imperial Insignia Office set up the grand and minor pavilions and positions for civil and military attendant ministers and foreign guests; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices set up music positions, spirit positions, tablet positions, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the associated Thearch's chamber, the Imperial Insignia Office arranged the grand and minor pavilions and seating for civil and military attendants and foreign guests, while the Court of Imperial Sacrifices arranged music stands, spirit positions, and tablet placements.

sentences.zh: 前一日司尊彝帥其屬以法陳祭器於堂東，僕射、禮部尚書視滌濯告潔，禮部尚書、侍郎省牲，光祿卿奉牲，告充、告備，禮部尚書視鼎鑊，禮部侍郎視腥熟之節。

translations.literal: On the previous day the Director of Ritual Vessels led his subordinates to arrange sacrificial vessels by regulation east of the hall; the Grand Counselor and Minister of Rites inspected washing and announced purity; the Minister and Vice Minister of Rites inspected the victims; the Director of Imperial Commissariat presented the victims and announced sufficiency and readiness; the Minister of Rites inspected the cauldrons; the Vice Minister of Rites inspected the stages of raw and cooked.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of sacrifice, the Director of Ritual Vessels arranged the vessels east of the hall. The Grand Counselor and Minister of Rites inspected the washing and declared purity. The Minister and Vice Minister of Rites inspected the sacrificial animals; the Director of the Imperial Commissariat presented them and announced sufficiency and readiness. The Minister of Rites inspected the cauldrons, and the Vice Minister the stages of preparation from raw to cooked.

sentences.zh: 祭之旦，光祿卿率其屬取籩、豆、簠、簋實之。

translations.literal: On the morning of sacrifice, the Director of Imperial Commissariat led his subordinates to fill the platters, bowls, grain vessels, and food vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On the morning of sacrifice, the Director of the Imperial Commissariat had his staff fill the platters, bowls, and grain vessels.

sentences.zh: 及薦腥，禮部尚書帥其屬薦籩、豆、簠、簋，戶部、兵部、工部尚書薦三牲之腥熟俎。

translations.literal: When presenting the raw offering, the Minister of Rites led his subordinates to present the platters, bowls, grain vessels, and food vessels; the Ministers of Revenue, War, and Works presented the raw and cooked trays of the three victims.
translations.idiomatic: When presenting the raw offering, the Minister of Rites presented the platters and vessels, while the Ministers of Revenue, War, and Works presented the raw and cooked trays of the three sacrificial animals.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，各徹，而有司受之以出。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, each was withdrawn and the responsible offices received them and removed them.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite concluded, the offerings were withdrawn and received by the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 晡後，郊社令帥其屬掃除，御史按視之。

translations.literal: After mid-afternoon, the Director of Suburban and Altar Affairs led his subordinates in sweeping; the censor inspected.
translations.idiomatic: After mid-afternoon, the Director of Suburban and Altar Affairs led his staff in sweeping the site, which the censor inspected.

sentences.zh: 奏中嚴外辦以禮部侍郎，請解嚴以禮部郎中。

translations.literal: Reporting mid-solemnity and outer readiness was the duty of the Vice Minister of Rites; requesting release from solemnity was the duty of the Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister of Rites announced mid-solemnity and outer readiness; the Director of the Ministry of Rites requested release from solemnity.

sentences.zh: 贊者設亞、終獻位於小次之南，宗室位於其後；

translations.literal: The invoker set the secondary and final offering positions south of the minor pavilion, with the imperial clan behind them;
translations.idiomatic: The invoker placed the secondary and final offering positions south of the minor pavilion, with the imperial clan behind;

sentences.zh: 設公卿位於亞、終獻之南，分獻官位於公卿之後，執事者又在其後，俱重行，西向北上。

translations.literal: set dukes and ministers south of the secondary and final offerings, separate offering officials behind the dukes and ministers, and officiants again behind them — all in double rows, facing west and proceeding north.
translations.idiomatic: dukes and ministers south of those, separate offering officials behind them, and officiants behind again — all in double rows, facing west and aligned northward.

sentences.zh: 其致福也，太牢以牛左肩、臂、臑折九個，少牢以羊左肩七個、犆豕以左肩五個。

translations.literal: For presenting blessing, the great victim used nine pieces from the ox's left shoulder, arm, and shank; the lesser victim seven pieces from the sheep's left shoulder; the single victim five pieces from the pig's left shoulder.
translations.idiomatic: For the blessing offering, the great victim required nine cuts from the ox's left shoulder, arm, and shank; the lesser victim seven from the sheep's left shoulder; and the single victim five from the pig's left shoulder.

sentences.zh: 有司攝事、進胙皆如禮。

translations.literal: Officials performing by proxy and presenting the sacrificial meat all followed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Proxy officiants and the presentation of sacrificial meat all followed ritual precedent.

sentences.zh: 太尉展視以授使者，再拜稽首。

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant unfolded and inspected, then handed to the envoy, who bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant inspected the offering and handed it to the envoy, who bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground.

sentences.zh: 既享，大宴，號曰飲福，自宰臣而下至應執事及樂工、馭車馬人等，並均給有差，以為定式。

translations.literal: After the sacrifice, a great feast was held, called Drinking Blessing; from the chief minister down to all who should officiate, musicians, charioteers, and the like — all were given shares in graded amounts, established as the fixed pattern.
translations.idiomatic: After the sacrifice came the great feast called Drinking Blessing. From the chief minister down through all officiants, musicians, and charioteers, shares were distributed in graded amounts as the fixed practice.

sentences.zh: 是歲十一月日至，皇帝服袞冕，執圭，合祭天地於圜丘，還禦明德門樓，肆赦。

translations.literal: That year on the day of the eleventh month's solstice, the emperor wore dark robes and coronet, held the jade tablet, jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound, returned to ascend the Bright Virtue Gate tower, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: That year on the winter solstice of the eleventh month, the emperor wore dark ceremonial robes and coronet, held the jade tablet, and jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound. He then returned to the Bright Virtue Gate tower and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天聖二年，詔加真宗諡，上謂輔臣曰：「郊祀重事，朕欲就禁中習儀，其令禮官草具以聞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiansheng under Emperor Renzong, when an edict added a posthumous title for Zhenzong, the emperor told his ministers: 'The suburban sacrifice is a weighty affair; I wish to practice the rites within the palace precinct. Have the ritual officials draft the procedures and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiansheng (1024), as an edict added a posthumous title for Emperor Zhenzong, the emperor told his ministers: "The suburban sacrifice is a weighty affair. I wish to rehearse the rites within the palace. Have the ritual officials draft the procedures and report."

sentences.zh: 」先郊三日，奉諡冊寶於太廟。

translations.literal: ' Three days before the suburban sacrifice, the posthumous title registers and seals were presented at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Three days before the suburban sacrifice, the posthumous title registers and seals were presented at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 次日，薦享玉清昭應、景靈宮，宿太廟。

translations.literal: The next day, offerings were presented at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response and Splendid Spirit palaces; he lodged at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, offerings were presented at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response and Splendid Spirit palaces, and the emperor lodged at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 既享，赴青城，至大次，就更衣壇改服袞冕行事。

translations.literal: After the offering, he proceeded to the Azure City, reached the grand pavilion, changed into dark robes and coronet at the robing altar, and performed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: After the offering, he proceeded to the Azure City, reached the grand pavilion, changed into dark ceremonial robes at the robing altar, and performed the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 五年，郊後擇日恭謝，大禮使王曾請節廟樂，帝曰：「三年一享，不敢憚勞也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, after the suburban sacrifice a day was chosen for reverent thanksgiving; Grand Ritual Commissioner Wang Zeng requested reducing temple music; the emperor said: 'Once every three years we enjoy sacrifice — I dare not shrink from the labor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, a day was chosen after the suburban sacrifice for reverent thanksgiving. Grand Ritual Commissioner Wang Zeng asked to reduce temple music, but the emperor replied: "We sacrifice only once every three years — I dare not shrink from the effort."

sentences.zh: 」三獻終，增禮生七人，各引本室太祝升殿，徹豆。

translations.literal: ' When the three offerings were complete, seven additional ritual students were added; each led the Grand Invoker of his chamber up the hall to withdraw the beans.
translations.idiomatic: When the three offerings were complete, seven additional ritual students were added, each leading his chamber's Grand Invoker up the hall to withdraw the bean vessels.

sentences.zh: 三日，又齋長春殿，謝玉清昭應宮。

translations.literal: On the third day, he again fasted in the Everlasting Spring Hall and gave thanks at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day, he fasted again in the Everlasting Spring Hall and gave thanks at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，賀皇太后，比籍田，勞酒儀，略如元會。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, he congratulated the Empress Dowager; compared with the plowing ceremony, the reward-wine rites were much like the New Year's audience.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites concluded, he congratulated the Empress Dowager. The reward-wine ceremony resembled the New Year's audience, much as at the plowing ceremony.

sentences.zh: 其恭謝云：「臣某虔遵舊典，郊祀禮成，中外協心，不勝歡抃。

translations.literal: The reverent thanksgiving read: 'Your subject so-and-so reverently follows the old regulations; the suburban sacrifice rites are complete; within and without are of one heart — I cannot contain my joy.
translations.idiomatic: The thanksgiving address read: "Your subject reverently follows the established regulations. The suburban sacrifice is complete, and all within and without the court are united in joy beyond measure."

sentences.zh: 」宣答曰：「皇帝德備孝恭，禮成嚴配，萬國稱頌，歡豫增深。

translations.literal: ' The response announced: 'The emperor's virtue is complete in filial piety and respect; the rites are accomplished in solemn matching; the ten thousand states praise — joy and delight increase ever deeper.
translations.idiomatic: The response announced: "The emperor's virtue is complete in filial piety and respect. The rites are accomplished in solemn matching. The ten thousand states offer praise, and joy increases ever deeper."

sentences.zh: 」帝再拜還內。

translations.literal: ' The emperor bowed twice and returned within.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bowed twice and returned within.

sentences.zh: 樞密使以下稱賀，閣門使宣答，樞密副使升殿侍立，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: From the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner down, congratulations were offered; the Gatekeeper announced responses; the vice commissioner of military affairs ascended the hall to attend standing; all officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: From the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner downward, officials offered congratulations. The Gatekeeper announced the responses, the vice commissioner ascended to attend, and all officials congratulated the emperor.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，還內殿，受命婦賀，司賓自殿側幕次引內命婦於殿庭，北向立，尚儀奏：「請皇太后即御坐。

translations.literal: After three rounds of wine, returning to the inner hall, titled consorts offered congratulations; the Master of Guests from the side curtain behind the hall led the inner titled consorts into the court, standing facing north; the Director of Ceremonies reported: 'We request that the Empress Dowager take her imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: After three rounds of wine, the emperor returned to the inner hall for congratulations from titled consorts. The Master of Guests led the inner consorts from the side curtain into the courtyard, where they stood facing north. The Director of Ceremonies announced: "We request that the Empress Dowager take her seat."

sentences.zh: 」司賓贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: ' The Master of Guests intoned: 'Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Guests intoned: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」引班首升自西階，稱封號妾某氏等言：「郊祀再舉，福祚鹹均，凡在照臨，不勝忻抃。

translations.literal: ' He led the head of the rank up the western steps; she announced her title and name, saying: 'The suburban sacrifice has again been performed; blessings and fortune are equally shared; all within your illumination — we cannot contain our joy.
translations.idiomatic: He led the senior consort up the western steps. She announced her title and said: "The suburban sacrifice has again been performed. Blessings are equally shared, and all within your radiance rejoice beyond measure."

sentences.zh: 」降，再拜。

translations.literal: ' She descended and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: She descended and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 尚宮承旨，降自東階，稱「皇太后聖旨」，又再拜。

translations.literal: The Palace Superintendent received the edict, descended the eastern steps, announced 'the Empress Dowager's sacred command,' and bowed twice again.
