translations.idiomatic: The Palace Superintendent received the command, descended the eastern steps, announced the Empress Dowager's sacred decree, and all bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 司賓宣答曰「已成钜禮，歡豫良深。

translations.literal: The Master of Guests announced the response: 'The great rite is already accomplished; joy and delight are truly deep.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Guests announced the response: "The great rite is accomplished, and joy is truly profound."

sentences.zh: 」皆再拜。

translations.literal: ' All bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 次外命婦賀，如內命婦儀，退，皆赴別殿賀皇帝，惟不致詞，不宣答。

translations.literal: Next the outer titled consorts congratulated, following the inner consorts' rites; they withdrew and all proceeded to a separate hall to congratulate the emperor — only without presenting addresses or announcing responses.
translations.idiomatic: Outer titled consorts then congratulated following the same rites, withdrew, and proceeded to a separate hall to congratulate the emperor — but without formal addresses or announced responses.

sentences.zh: 神宗元豐六年十一月二日，帝將親郊，奉仁宗、英宗徽號冊寶於太廟。

translations.literal: On the second day of the eleventh month of the sixth year of Yuanfeng under Emperor Shenzong, as the emperor was about to perform the suburban sacrifice in person, the honorific title registers and seals of Renzong and Yingzong were presented at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the eleventh month of the sixth year of Yuanfeng (1083), as Emperor Shenzong prepared to conduct the suburban sacrifice in person, the honorific registers and seals of Renzong and Yingzong were presented at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 是日晚，齋於大慶殿。

translations.literal: That evening he fasted in the Great Celebration Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That evening he fasted in the Great Celebration Hall.

sentences.zh: 三日，薦享于景靈宮，齋於太廟。

translations.literal: On the third day, offerings were presented at the Splendid Spirit Palace; he fasted at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day, offerings were presented at the Splendid Spirit Palace, and he fasted at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 四日，朝享七室，齋於南郊之青城。

translations.literal: On the fourth day, he attended morning sacrifice in the seven chambers; he fasted at the Azure City of the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day, he attended morning sacrifice in the seven chambers and fasted at the Southern Suburb's Azure City.

sentences.zh: 五日冬至，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，以太祖配。

translations.literal: On the fifth day, the winter solstice, the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound, with the Founding Ancestor as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day, the winter solstice, he sacrificed to the Supreme Thearch of Vast Heaven at the Round Mound with the Founding Ancestor as associate.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝服靴袍，乘輦至大次。

translations.literal: That day the emperor wore boots and robe, rode the imperial carriage to the grand pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor wore everyday boots and robe and rode the imperial carriage to the grand pavilion.

sentences.zh: 有司請行禮。

translations.literal: The responsible offices requested that the rites proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials requested that the rites begin.

sentences.zh: 服大裘，被袞冕以出，至壇中壝門外，殿中監進大圭，帝執以入，宮架樂作，至午階下版位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: He donned the great fur robe, put on dark robes and coronet and emerged, reaching outside the middle enclosure gate of the altar; the Palace Superintendent presented the great jade tablet; the emperor held it and entered; palace music sounded; he reached the tablet position below the noon stairway, stood facing west; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He donned the great fur robe and dark ceremonial coronet, emerged to the gate of the middle enclosure, received the great jade tablet from the Palace Superintendent, and entered as palace music sounded. He reached the tablet position below the noon stairway, stood facing west, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使贊曰：「有司謹具，請行事。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of Ritual intoned: 'The responsible offices have reverently prepared — we request that the rites proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioner of Ritual intoned: "The responsible offices have duly prepared. We request that the rites proceed."

sentences.zh: 」宮架奏《景安》之樂，文舞作六成，止，帝再拜，詣罍洗，宮架樂作，至洗南北向，樂止。

translations.literal: ' Palace music performed the Jing'an hymn; the civil dance was performed in six sections and stopped; the emperor bowed twice, proceeded to the urn for washing; palace music sounded; he reached the wash, stood facing north; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music performed the hymn Jing'an. The civil dance ran six sections and stopped. The emperor bowed twice and proceeded to the washing urn as music sounded again. He reached the basin, stood facing north, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 帝搢圭，盥帨訖，樂作，至壇下，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor inserted the tablet, finished washing hands and drying with the towel; music sounded; he reached the foot of the altar; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor inserted the tablet, washed his hands, and dried them. Music sounded as he reached the foot of the altar, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 升午階，登歌樂作，至壇上，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascended the noon stairway; ascending hymn music sounded; he reached the top of the altar; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the noon stairway as the ascending hymn sounded, reached the altar summit, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 殿中監進鎮圭，《嘉安》樂作，詣上帝神坐前，北向跪，奠鎮圭於繅藉，執大圭，俯伏，興，搢圭跪，三上香，奠玉幣，執圭，俯伏，興，再拜。

translations.literal: The Palace Superintendent presented the securing jade tablet; the Jia'an hymn sounded; he proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, knelt facing north, placed the securing tablet on the silk mat, held the great tablet, prostrated himself, rose, inserted the tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, presented jade and silk, held the tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Superintendent presented the securing jade tablet as the hymn Jia'an sounded. The emperor proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, knelt facing north, placed the securing tablet on the silk mat, held the great tablet, prostrated himself, rose, inserted the tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, presented jade and silk, held the tablet, prostrated himself again, rose, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 內侍舉鎮圭授殿中監，樂止。

translations.literal: The inner attendant raised the securing tablet and handed it to the Palace Superintendent; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant raised the securing tablet and handed it to the Palace Superintendent, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 《廣安》樂作，詣太祖神坐前，東向，奠圭幣如上帝儀。

translations.literal: The Guang'an hymn sounded; he proceeded before the Founding Ancestor's spirit seat, facing east, and presented jade and silk as at the Supreme Thearch's rite.
translations.idiomatic: The hymn Guang'an sounded as he proceeded before the Founding Ancestor's spirit seat, facing east, and presented jade and silk following the same rite as for the Supreme Thearch.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，帝降壇，樂止。

translations.literal: The ascending hymn sounded; the emperor descended the altar; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ascending hymn sounded. The emperor descended the altar, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，還位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Palace music sounded; he returned to his position, stood facing west; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music sounded as he returned to his position and stood facing west, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書、戶部尚書以下奉饌俎，宮架《豐安》樂作，奉奠訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The Minister of Rites, Minister of Revenue, and those below presented the food trays; palace music performed Feng'an; the presentation was complete; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Rites, Minister of Revenue, and officials below presented the food trays as palace music performed Feng'an. When the presentation was complete, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 再詣罍洗，帝搢大圭，盥帨，洗爵拭爵訖，執大圭，宮架樂作，至壇下，樂止。

translations.literal: He again proceeded to the urn for washing; the emperor inserted the great tablet, washed hands and dried with the towel, washed and wiped the goblet; holding the great tablet, palace music sounded; he reached the foot of the altar; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He again proceeded to the washing urn. The emperor inserted the great tablet, washed his hands, dried them, and washed and wiped the goblet. Holding the great tablet, he descended to the foot of the altar as palace music sounded, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 升自午階，登歌樂作，至壇上，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascended by the noon stairway; the ascending hymn sounded; he reached the top of the altar; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the noon stairway as the ascending hymn sounded, reached the altar summit, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 登歌《禧安》樂作，詣上帝神坐前，搢圭跪，執爵祭酒，三奠訖，執圭，俯伏，興，樂止。

translations.literal: The ascending hymn Xi'an sounded; he proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, inserted the tablet and knelt, held the goblet and libated wine, completed three pourings, held the tablet, prostrated himself, rose; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ascending hymn Xi'an sounded. He proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, inserted the tablet and knelt, libated wine three times, held the tablet, prostrated himself, and rose as the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 太祝讀冊，帝再拜訖，樂作。

translations.literal: The Grand Invoker read the register; the emperor bowed twice; music sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Invoker read the prayer text. The emperor bowed twice, and music sounded.

sentences.zh: 次詣太祖神坐前，如前儀。

translations.literal: Next he proceeded before the Founding Ancestor's spirit seat, following the previous rite.
translations.idiomatic: Next he proceeded before the Founding Ancestor's spirit seat following the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，帝降自午階，樂止。

translations.literal: The ascending hymn sounded; the emperor descended by the noon stairway; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ascending hymn sounded as the emperor descended the noon stairway, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，還位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Palace music sounded; he returned to his position, stood facing west; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music sounded as he returned to his position and stood facing west, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 文舞退，武舞進，宮架《正安》之樂作，樂止。

translations.literal: The civil dance withdrew, the military dance advanced; palace music performed Zheng'an; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dance withdrew and the military dance advanced as palace music performed Zheng'an, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 亞獻盥帨訖，《正安》樂作，禮畢，樂止。

translations.literal: When the secondary offering officiant had finished washing hands and drying, Zheng'an sounded; the rite was complete; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: After the secondary offering officiant finished washing his hands, Zheng'an sounded, the rite concluded, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 終獻行禮並如上儀，獻畢，宮架樂作，帝升自午階，樂止。

translations.literal: The final offering proceeded according to the above rite; when the offerings were complete, palace music sounded; the emperor ascended by the noon stairway; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The final offering followed the same procedure. When the offerings were complete, palace music sounded as the emperor ascended the noon stairway, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，至飲福位，樂止。

translations.literal: The ascending hymn sounded; he reached the Drinking Blessing position; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ascending hymn sounded as he reached the Drinking Blessing position, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 《禧安》樂作，帝再拜，搢圭跪，受爵，祭酒三，啐酒，奠爵，受俎，奠俎，受摶黍豆，再受爵，飲福訖，奠爵，執圭，俯伏，興，再拜，樂作。

translations.literal: The Xi'an hymn sounded; the emperor bowed twice, inserted the tablet and knelt, received the goblet, libated wine three times, sipped the wine, set down the goblet, received the tray, set down the tray, received the millet and beans, received the goblet again, finished drinking the blessing, set down the goblet, held the tablet, prostrated himself, rose, bowed twice; music sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The hymn Xi'an sounded. The emperor bowed twice, inserted the tablet and knelt, received the goblet, libated three times, sipped the wine, and set down the goblet. He received the meat tray and set it down, received the millet and beans, received the goblet again, and finished drinking the blessing. He set down the goblet, held the tablet, prostrated himself, rose, bowed twice, and music sounded.

sentences.zh: 帝降，還位如前儀。

translations.literal: The emperor descended and returned to his position as in the previous rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended and returned to his position as before.

sentences.zh: 禮部、戶部尚書徹俎豆，禮直官曰：「賜胙行事。

translations.literal: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue withdrew the trays and beans; the ritual officer announced: 'Bestow the sacrificial meat and proceed with the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue withdrew the trays and vessels. The ritual officer announced: "Bestow the sacrificial meat and proceed with the rites."

sentences.zh: 」陪祀官再拜，宮架《宴安》樂作，一成止。

translations.literal: ' Attendant sacrifice officials bowed twice; palace music performed Yan'an for one section and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant sacrifice officials bowed twice as palace music performed Yan'an for one section and stopped.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，帝詣望燎位，南向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Palace music sounded; the emperor proceeded to the position for gazing at the burning; he stood facing south; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music sounded as the emperor proceeded to the burning-watching position and stood facing south, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官曰：「可燎。

translations.literal: The ritual officer said: 'The burning may proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer announced: "The burning may proceed."

sentences.zh: 」俟火燎半柴，禮儀使跪奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: ' When the fire had burned half the firewood, the Commissioner of Ritual knelt and reported: 'The rites are complete.
translations.idiomatic: When the fire had burned halfway through the firewood, the Commissioner of Ritual knelt and reported: "The rites are complete."

sentences.zh: 」宮架樂作，帝出中壝門，殿中監受大圭，歸大次，樂止。

translations.literal: ' Palace music sounded; the emperor exited the middle enclosure gate; the Palace Superintendent received the great tablet; he returned to the grand pavilion; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music sounded as the emperor exited the middle enclosure gate. The Palace Superintendent received the great tablet, and the emperor returned to the grand pavilion as the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 有司奏解嚴。

translations.literal: The responsible offices reported release from solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices announced release from solemnity.

sentences.zh: 帝乘輿還青城，百官稱賀於端誠殿。

translations.literal: The emperor rode the imperial carriage back to the Azure City; all officials offered congratulations in the Sincere Integrity Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode back to the Azure City, and all officials offered congratulations in the Sincere Integrity Hall.

sentences.zh: 有司轉仗衛，奏中嚴外辦。

translations.literal: The responsible offices shifted the guard of honor and reported mid-solemnity and outer readiness.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices shifted the guard of honor and announced mid-solemnity and outer readiness.

sentences.zh: 帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，乘輿以出。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the heaven-piercing cap and crimson gauze robe and rode the imperial carriage out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the heaven-piercing cap and crimson gauze robe and rode out in the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 至玉輅所，侍中跪請降輿升輅。

translations.literal: Reaching the jade carriage, the Palace Attendant knelt and requested that he descend the palanquin and ascend the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: At the jade carriage, the Palace Attendant knelt and asked the emperor to descend the palanquin and board the carriage.

sentences.zh: 帝升輅，門下侍郎奏請進行，又奏請少駐，侍臣乘馬，將至宣德門，奏《采薺》一曲，入門，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the carriage; the Vice Director of the Secretariat reported requesting to proceed, then reported requesting a brief halt; attendant ministers rode horses; as they neared the Xuande Gate, one piece of Gathering Shepherd's Purse was performed; entering the gate, music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor boarded the carriage. The Vice Director of the Secretariat requested departure, then a brief halt. Attendant ministers rode on horseback. Approaching the Xuande Gate, Gathering Shepherd's Purse was performed once before they entered the gate and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 侍中請降輅赴幄次，有司奏解嚴。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant requested descent from the carriage to proceed to the tent quarters; the responsible offices reported release from solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant asked the emperor to descend and proceed to the tent quarters, and the responsible offices announced release from solemnity.

sentences.zh: 帝常服，乘輿禦宣德門，肆赦，群臣稱賀如常儀。

translations.literal: In everyday dress the emperor rode the imperial carriage to the Xuande Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and the assembled ministers congratulated him according to regular rites.
translations.idiomatic: In everyday dress the emperor rode to the Xuande Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and the ministers congratulated him according to regular ceremony.

sentences.zh: 神宗之嗣位也，英宗之喪未除。

translations.literal: When Shenzong succeeded to the throne, Yingzong's mourning had not yet been completed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong succeeded to the throne, mourning for Yingzong had not yet ended.

sentences.zh: 是歲當郊，帝以為疑，以問講讀官王珪、司馬光、王安石，皆對以不當廢。

translations.literal: That year a suburban sacrifice was due; the emperor was uncertain and asked the lecture officials Wang Gui, Sima Guang, and Wang Anshi — all replied that it should not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: A suburban sacrifice was due that year. The emperor was uncertain and consulted lecture officials Wang Gui, Sima Guang, and Wang Anshi. All replied that it should not be canceled.

sentences.zh: 珪又謂：「'喪三年不祭，惟祭天地、社稷，為越紼而行事。

translations.literal: Gui further said: '"During the three-year mourning one does not sacrifice, except to Heaven and Earth and the altars of soil and grain — one performs the rites by stepping over the mourning cord.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui added: "During the three-year mourning period one does not sacrifice except to Heaven and Earth and the altars of soil and grain — one performs the rites by stepping over the mourning cord."

sentences.zh: '《傳》謂：'不敢以卑廢尊也。

translations.literal: ' The Commentary says: "One dare not let the humble abolish the exalted."
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary states: "One dare not let the humble abolish the exalted."

sentences.zh: '景德二年，真宗居明德太后之喪，即易月而服除。

translations.literal: ' In the second year of Jingde, when Zhenzong was in mourning for Empress Dowager Mingde, he changed the month and completed mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingde, when Zhenzong was mourning Empress Dowager Mingde, he shortened the mourning period and completed it.

sentences.zh: 明年遂享太廟，而合祀天地於圜丘。

translations.literal: The next year he then enjoyed sacrifice at the Grand Temple and jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he sacrificed at the Grand Temple and jointly honored Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 請冬至行郊廟之禮，其服冕、車輅、儀物、音樂緣神事者皆不可廢。

translations.literal: We request that the suburban and temple rites be performed at the winter solstice; the coronet and robes, carriage, ritual objects, and music pertaining to the divine rites must none be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the suburban and temple rites be performed at the winter solstice. The coronet and robes, carriage, ritual objects, and music pertaining to the divine rites must not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 」詔用景德故事，惟郊廟及景靈宮禮神用樂，鹵簿鼓吹及樓前宮架、諸軍音樂，皆備而不作，警場止鳴金鉦、鼓角，仍罷諸軍呈閱騎隊。

translations.literal: ' An edict adopted the Jingde precedent: only at the suburban altars, temples, and Splendid Spirit Palace was music used in honoring the spirits; the imperial escort drums, palace music before the tower, and military music were all prepared but not performed; the alert ground sounded only gongs and horns, and the military cavalry review was still suspended.
translations.idiomatic: An edict adopted the Jingde precedent: music was used only at the suburban altars, temples, and Splendid Spirit Palace to honor the spirits. Imperial escort drums, tower palace music, and military music were prepared but not performed. The alert ground sounded only gongs and horns, and the military cavalry review was suspended.

sentences.zh: 故事，齋宿必禦樓警嚴，幸後苑觀花，作水戲，至是悉罷之。

translations.literal: By precedent, during the fasting vigil one always mounted the tower for the alert, visited the rear garden to view flowers, and staged water performances — all of these were now suspended.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, during the fasting vigil the emperor mounted the tower for the alert, visited the rear garden to view flowers, and staged water performances — all of which were now suspended.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「故事，當謁謝於祖宗神禦殿，獻享月吉禮，以禮官攝。

translations.literal: The responsible offices said: 'By precedent, one should visit and give thanks at the ancestral spirit halls, and the monthly auspicious offering should be performed by ritual officials by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices reported: "By precedent, one should visit the ancestral spirit halls to give thanks, and the monthly auspicious offering should be performed by ritual officials acting as proxy."

sentences.zh: 」詔遣輔臣仍罷詣佛寺。

translations.literal: ' An edict dispatched chief ministers but still suspended visits to Buddhist temples.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched chief ministers but still suspended visits to Buddhist temples.

sentences.zh: 是後國有故，皆遣輔臣。

translations.literal: Thereafter, whenever the state had occasion for mourning, chief ministers were always dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, whenever the state was in mourning, chief ministers were always dispatched in the emperor's place.

sentences.zh: 高宗紹興十二年，臣僚言：「自南巡以來，三歲之祀，獨於明堂，而郊天之禮未舉，來歲乞行大禮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shaoxing under Emperor Gaozong, officials reported: 'Since the southern tour, the triennial sacrifices have been performed only at the Bright Hall, while the rite of sacrificing to Heaven has not been held — we request the great rite be performed next year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Shaoxing (1142), officials reported: "Since the court moved south, triennial sacrifices have been held only at the Bright Hall, while the Heaven sacrifice has not been performed. We ask that the great rite be held next year."

sentences.zh: 」詔建圜壇于臨安府行宮東城之外，自是凡六郊焉。

translations.literal: ' An edict ordered a round altar built outside the eastern wall of the traveling palace in Lin'an Prefecture; from then on suburban sacrifices were performed six times in all.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a round altar built outside the eastern wall of the imperial residence in Lin'an. Six suburban sacrifices were performed thereafter.

sentences.zh: 孝宗隆興二年，詔曰：「聯恭覽國史，太祖乾德詔書有云：'務從省約，無至勞煩。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing under Emperor Xiaozong, an edict stated: 'We have reverently perused the dynastic history; an edict of the Founding Ancestor in Qiande reads: "Strive for economy and simplicity; do not go so far as to cause toil and trouble."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longxing (1164), an edict stated: "We have reverently reviewed the dynastic history. An edict of the Founding Ancestor in Qiande reads: 'Strive for economy and simplicity; do not cause undue toil and trouble.'"

sentences.zh: '仰見事天之誠，愛民之仁，所以垂萬世之統者在是。

translations.literal: ' Looking up, one sees the sincerity of serving Heaven and the benevolence of loving the people — therein lies what transmits the imperial succession for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: In this one sees the sincerity of serving Heaven and the benevolence of loving the people — the foundation on which the imperial succession is transmitted for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 今歲郊見，可令有司，除禮物、軍賞，其餘並從省約。

translations.literal: For this year's suburban audience with Heaven, the responsible offices may be ordered that apart from ritual gifts and military rewards, all else should follow economy and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: For this year's suburban audience with Heaven, the responsible offices are directed that apart from ritual gifts and military rewards, all else should follow economy and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 初降詔以十一月行事，以冬至適在晦日，以至道典故，改用獻歲上辛，遂改來年元為乾道。

translations.literal: An edict was first issued to perform the rite in the eleventh month; because the winter solstice fell on the last day of the month, following the Zhidao precedent the first xin day of the offering year was adopted instead, and the next year's era name was changed to Qiandao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict initially scheduled the rite for the eleventh month, but because the winter solstice fell on the month's last day, following the Zhidao precedent the first xin day of the offering year was chosen instead, and the next year's era name was changed to Qiandao.

sentences.zh: 乃以正月一日有事南郊，禮成，進胙于德壽宮，以牛腥體肩三、臂上臑二。

translations.literal: The suburban sacrifice was then performed on the first day of the first month; when the rite was complete, sacrificial meat was presented at the Virtue and Longevity Palace — three shoulder cuts and two upper-arm cuts from the raw ox.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Suburb sacrifice was performed on the first day of the first month. When the rite concluded, sacrificial meat was presented at the Virtue and Longevity Palace: three shoulder cuts and two upper-arm cuts from the raw ox.

sentences.zh: 導駕官自端誠殿簪花從駕至德壽宮上壽，飲福稱賀，陳設儀注，並同上壽禮。

translations.literal: Escort officials with flowers in their caps followed the imperial carriage from the Sincere Integrity Hall to the Virtue and Longevity Palace to offer longevity congratulations, drinking blessing and offering congratulations; the arrangements and procedures all followed the longevity rite.
translations.idiomatic: Escort officials wearing flowers in their caps followed the imperial carriage from the Sincere Integrity Hall to the Virtue and Longevity Palace to offer longevity congratulations, drink the blessing wine, and celebrate — all following the standard longevity ceremony.

sentences.zh: 皇帝致詞曰：「皇帝臣某言：享帝合宮，受天純嘏，臣某與百僚不勝大慶，謹上千萬歲壽。

translations.literal: The emperor's address read: 'The emperor your subject so-and-so states: Having sacrificed to the Thearch at the Bright Hall and received Heaven's pure blessing, your subject and the hundred officials cannot contain our great rejoicing — we respectfully offer ten thousand years of life.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's address read: "Your subject the emperor reports: Having sacrificed to the Thearch at the Bright Hall and received Heaven's pure blessing, your subject and the hundred officials rejoice beyond measure and respectfully offer ten thousand years of life."

sentences.zh: 」自後郊祀、明堂進胙飲福，並如上儀。

translations.literal: ' Thereafter, presenting sacrificial meat and drinking blessing at suburban sacrifice and Bright Hall all followed the above rite.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, presenting sacrificial meat and drinking the blessing wine at suburban sacrifice and Bright Hall ceremonies all followed this procedure.

sentences.zh: 光宗紹熙二年十一月郊，以值雨，行禮於望祭殿。

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice in the eleventh month of the second year of Shaoxi under Emperor Guangzong, rain intervened and the rites were performed in the Hall for Gazing Sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice in the eleventh month of the second year of Shaoxi (1191), rain forced the rites to be performed in the Hall for Gazing Sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 帝遂感疾。

translations.literal: The emperor then fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then fell ill.

sentences.zh: 理宗四十一年，一郊而已。

translations.literal: In forty-one years under Emperor Lizong, only one suburban sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: During Lizong's forty-one-year reign, only one suburban sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 度宗鹹淳二年，權工部尚書趙汝暨等奏：「今歲大禮，正在先帝大祥之後，臣等竊惟帝王受命，郊見天地，不可緩也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianchun under Emperor Duzong, Acting Minister of Works Zhao Ruji and others memorialized: 'This year's great rite falls just after the late emperor's da xiang mourning; we respectfully consider that when an emperor receives the mandate, audience with Heaven and Earth at the suburb cannot be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianchun (1266), Acting Minister of Works Zhao Ruji and others memorialized: "This year's great rite falls just after the late emperor's da xiang mourning. We respectfully observe that when an emperor receives the mandate, audience with Heaven and Earth at the suburb cannot be delayed."

sentences.zh: 古者有改元即郊，不用前郊三年為計。

translations.literal: In antiquity some performed the suburban sacrifice upon changing the era name, not calculating from the previous suburb three years prior.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity some performed the suburban sacrifice upon changing the era name, without calculating from the previous suburb three years earlier.

sentences.zh: 況今適在當郊之歲，既逾大祥之期，圜丘之祀，豈容不舉？

translations.literal: Moreover, this is precisely the year when the suburb is due, and the da xiang period has already passed — how can sacrifice at the Round Mound be allowed not to be held?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, this is precisely the year when the suburb is due, and the da xiang period has passed. How can the Round Mound sacrifice be omitted?

sentences.zh: 」於是降禮，以十一月十七日款謁南郊，適太史院言：「十六日太陰交蝕。

translations.literal: ' Rites were then promulgated to perform a reverent visit to the Southern Suburb on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month; just then the Astronomical Bureau reported: 'On the sixteenth day the moon will undergo an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were promulgated for a reverent visit to the Southern Suburb on the seventeenth of the eleventh month, but the Astronomical Bureau reported: "A lunar eclipse will occur on the sixteenth."

sentences.zh: 」遂改來年正月一日南郊行禮，太常寺言：「皇帝既已從吉，請依儀用樂。

translations.literal: ' The rite was then moved to the first day of the first month of the following year. The Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: 'Since the emperor has already passed from mourning to auspicious days, we request that music be used according to the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The rite was moved to the first day of the first month of the following year. The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Since the emperor has completed mourning, we ask that music be used according to ritual precedent."

sentences.zh: 其十二月二十九日朝獻景靈宮，三十日朝享太廟，尚在禫制之內，所有迎神、奠幣、酌獻、送神作樂外，其盥洗升降行步等樂，備而不作。」

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month the court presentation at the Splendid Spirit Palace and on the thirtieth the morning offering at the Grand Temple still fell within the chan mourning — apart from music for welcoming the spirits, presenting silks, pouring offerings, and sending off the spirits, music for washing, ascending, descending, and procession was to be prepared but not performed.'
translations.idiomatic: The court presentation at the Splendid Spirit Palace on the twenty-ninth of the twelfth month and the morning offering at the Grand Temple on the thirtieth still fell within chan mourning. Apart from music for welcoming the spirits, presenting silks, pouring offerings, and sending them off, music for washing, ascending, descending, and procession was to be prepared but not performed."
